title: Prospective Witness-Preserving Causal Fiber Constitution, Intervention-Response Congruence, Counterexample-Guided Quotient Splitting, Held-Out Positive-Control Preservation, Cross-Engine Fiber Transport & Exact-Event Explanation Reconstruction

parent_authority.inherited_boundary: A hand-designed structural quotient can close one open Ethereal world but merges the already-certified Stockfish singleton cause with non-equivalent exact events. Structural similarity therefore lacks causal interchangeability authority.

objective: Constitute event fibers from intervention-induced search-trace responses rather than root outcomes or hand-designed structural labels; select the coarsest prospectively frozen diagnostic fiber level that is target-congruent on discovery worlds, then test the selected level unchanged on a binding Stockfish witness holdout and cross-engine transport worlds.

causal_fiber.unit: One exact P32 TT semantic-use event under a fixed engine/world/family/frontier/parent intervention context.
causal_fiber.diagnostic_intervention: Remove exactly one candidate exact event, conditioned on the frozen parent context, and compare the resulting TT semantic-use trace to the parent trace with the P33 outcome-blind lineage compiler.

target_query.primary: ROOT_CHANGE = whether singleton exact-event removal changes the parent's root bestmove at the frozen 80k-node measurement search.
target_query.separation: ROOT_CHANGE and the resulting bestmove are withheld from diagnostic fiber construction. They may be opened only by the discovery selector or later holdout/transport adjudication.

diagnostic_coordinates.class_flow: EMERGENT/VANISHED/DRIFTED counts by the four P32 semantic classes
diagnostic_coordinates.count_delta: counterfactual minus parent event-count vector by semantic class

causal_fiber.anti_triviality: No exact key, exact address, FEN, engine identity, root outcome, or unconstrained learned identifier may enter a fiber. A selected discovery level must contain at least one non-singleton fiber and fewer fibers than events; otherwise emit TRIVIAL_IDENTITY_HOLD.

candidate_selection.base_rule: From the parent trace at or above the frozen frontier, take distinct exact events ordered lexicographically by address_id and retain the first eight.
candidate_selection.binding_holdout_override: For the Stockfish positive-control world, include the inherited P33 witness address first, then fill remaining slots by the same lexicographic address_id rule excluding duplicates. This override is frozen because the witness identity is the object being held out, not because of any G9.5-P1 response.

parent_contexts.p34_inherited_worlds: For the two Ethereal discovery worlds and Stockfish binding holdout, reconstruct the P33 parent by CATALOG at the inherited frontier followed by exact removal of every baseline frontier address.
parent_contexts.historical_transport: For four P32 transport cases, use the native baseline CATALOG context at the P32 selected frontier; no P33 seed-removal condition is added.
parent_contexts.fresh_transport: For source-locked Stockfish Books positions, use a baseline CATALOG parent, family MOVE_ORDER+EVAL, frontier 1, and the same 1 MiB/Threads=1/20k-prime/three-20k-decoy/80k-measurement procedure.

discovery_and_freeze.target_collision: Within the pooled discovery records, a fiber is target-colliding when it contains both ROOT_CHANGE=true and ROOT_CHANGE=false events.
discovery_and_freeze.selection_rule: Starting at F0, choose the first level with zero discovery target collisions and nontrivial compression. If none passes through F3, emit DISCOVERY_FIBER_CONSTITUTION_HOLD and do not interpret later holdout/transport as confirmatory fiber evidence.
discovery_and_freeze.counterexample_guidance: A discovery collision authorizes only movement to the next already-frozen diagnostic level. No new coordinate, threshold, classifier, hash salt, budget, or case may be invented after observing G9.5-P1 discovery targets.
discovery_and_freeze.holdout_firewall: The binding Stockfish root responses are not produced until the discovery-selected level receipt is sealed.

pass_conditions: The inherited witness exact event fires under the reconstructed parent and its singleton removal changes the parent root bestmove.
At the discovery-selected F-level, every probed exact member sharing the witness fiber has the same ROOT_CHANGE label as the witness.
The level is not altered after holdout opening.
holdout_gate.failure: Any conflicting holdout member is WITNESS_FIBER_COLLISION and falsifies witness-preserving transport of the selected discovery fiber.

fresh_corpus.selection: SHA-256-ordered legal FENs; two targets; next three hash-ordered FENs as decoys; no engine output.

metrics: within-world fiber collision count under selected discovery level
transport.authority: Transport failure localizes context dependence of the diagnostic fiber. It does not authorize adding engine identity, FEN, or case labels to rescue the same stage.

allowed: exact event address prefix and semantic role
selected fiber level and diagnostic response signature
whether singleton removal changed the root move
fiber member count and measured congruence/collision status
legal parent and singleton-counterfactual root moves/PV facts
forbidden: claim that equal diagnostic fibers are metaphysically the same event

implementation_roles.C_or_Cpp: No new native intervention semantics. Reuse the already-sealed P34 executable variants in P34 BASE mode so the P32 exact-event hook remains the only active intervention mechanism.
implementation_roles.Rust: LawGen v11 constitution plus independent causal-fiber signature recomputation and target-leak audit.
implementation_roles.Python: Source-locked corpus materialization, exact-event replay orchestration, lineage-response diagnostics, discovery selection, legality and explanation compilation.

external_code_study.lesson: TTWriter/probe and relative-age replacement reinforce that storage-entry identity is not a causal event identity.
Search consumes TT move/value/eval/depth/bound through separate semantic roles; diagnostic fibers should be defined over intervention response, not raw table slot.
TTProbe exposes distinct score/eval/depth/bound/PV channels and supplies a materially different transport architecture.
DAG node/edge reuse shows that topology and identity may diverge; C3X keeps exact event provenance while testing behavioral equivalence.
Experiment execution and result adjudication are separated; G9.5 physically separates discovery selection from holdout execution.
Source-locked engine-development positions provide fresh transport worlds without outcome-conditioned cherry-picking.
Deterministic opening order/repetition informs reproducible corpus transport handling.
Used only for FEN/PV legality and deterministic chess atoms, never causal identity.

literature.role: Interventional structure rather than observational compression is the abstraction target.

literature.role: Event folding is legitimate only under behavior-preserving equivalence and preserved history.

literature.role: Counterexamples may refine a predeclared abstraction family without licensing arbitrary post-hoc feature invention.

literature.role: Transport is treated as an invariance test rather than an assumption.
Exact-event provenance and production paths constrain how causal explanations may be rendered.

claim_ceiling: A G9.5-P1 fiber is an operational equivalence class under a frozen lineage-response diagnostic and tested root-change query; it is not metaphysical event identity.
Discovery target congruence is not independent validation. The binding Stockfish holdout and transport worlds carry the validation burden.
The historical transport cases are not fresh evidence because their earlier P32 outcomes exist; fresh authority comes only from the source-locked corpus arm.
A singleton fiber may preserve a witness but does not by itself establish useful abstraction; discovery must show nontrivial compression.
Failure on transport cannot be repaired inside P1 by adding engine, FEN, full key, exact address, or new diagnostics.
No chess strategy, cognition, intent, prevalence, or population-level causal law is authorized.

verdict_ladder.rule: Apply this ladder mechanically after the selected discovery level is frozen. Historical transport is descriptive stress evidence; fresh source-locked transport determines transport authority.
